start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter, yaani boundary ki total length, padhenge. Aapka favourite shape kaunsa hai?

turns.line: samajh nahi aaya, ek example se samjhao
turns.reply: Jaise garden ko fence karna ho: 6 m, 4 m, 6 m, 4 m sides; perimeter ke liye sab jodiye. Total kitna aayega?
Kabir, aapko cricket pasand hai—end mein cricket par lautenge. Ab 6, 4, 6, 4 ko jodkar perimeter batayiye.

turns.board: Rani runs 3 rounds of a rectangular park 50 m long and 30 m wide. How far does she run?
turns.reply: Koi baat nahi, Kabir. Perimeter matlab sab sides ka total: 6 plus 4 plus 6 plus 4. Pehle 6 plus 4 kitna?
